# serverroom_account (Data Source)

The customer the API key belongs to, its services and the key's permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverroom_account" "me" {}

output "my_services" {
  value = data.serverroom_account.me.account_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_ids` (List of Number)
- `brand` (String)
- `scopes` (List of String)
- `uid` (Number)
